0.headline: Molbio Diagnostics IPO allotment today; GMP at 20% — check status on NSE, BSE and registrar
0.heading: Molbio Diagnostics IPO allotment today; GMP at 20% — check status on NSE, BSE and registrar
0.intro: Molbio Diagnostics is expected to finalise the basis of allotment for its Rs 940-crore initial public offering (IPO) today, on August 13, after the issue received strong demand across investor categories.
0.body:
Molbio Diagnostics is expected to finalise the basis of allotment for its Rs 940-crore initial public offering (IPO) today, on August 13, after the issue received strong demand across investor categories.

The IPO was subscribed 70.26 times by the end of bidding on August 12, according to data available on the National Stock Exchange (NSE).

The issue received bids for 57,32,14,392 equity shares against 81,58,529 shares on offer. Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIBs) led the demand, with their portion subscribed 186.39 times. The Non-Institutional Investor (NII) category was subscribed 49.80 times, while the retail portion was subscribed 12.96 times.

Read Also: Dhoot Transmission IPO allotment today; check status on registrar, BSE and NSE

The IPO opened for subscription on August 10 and closed on August 12. Molbio Diagnostics had fixed the price band at Rs 768 to Rs 807 per equity share.

According to IPO-tracking platforms InvestorGain and IPO Watch, Molbio Diagnostics shares were commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of Rs 154 over the upper end of the IPO price band of Rs 807.

At the upper price band, the GMP of Rs 154 indicates an estimated listing price of around Rs 961 . This translates into a potential premium of nearly 20 percent over the issue price.

The grey market premium is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment before listing and can change at any time. It does not guarantee the actual listing price or returns.

Molbio Diagnostics IPO allotment: How to check status

Investors can check their Molbio Diagnostics IPO allotment status once the basis of allotment is finalised. The status can be checked through the IPO registrar KFin Technologies and the BSE and NSE websites.

Molbio Diagnostics IPO allotment on KFin Technologies

Step 1. Visit the KFin Technologies IPO allotment page at https://ipostatus.kfintech.com/
Step 2. Select Molbio Diagnostics from the list of IPOs.
Step 3. Select the option to check the status using PAN, application number or DP ID/Client ID.
Step 4. Enter the relevant details.
Step 5. Enter the captcha shown on the screen.
Step 6. Click on Submit.
Step 7. Your Molbio Diagnostics IPO allotment status will appear on the screen.

Molbio Diagnostics IPO allotment on BSE

1. Visit the BSE website at https://www.bseindia.com/investors/appli_check
2. Select Equity as the issue type.
3. Select Molbio Diagnostics from the issue name.
4. Enter your PAN or application number.
5. Enter the captcha.
6. Click on Submit.
7. The IPO allotment status will be displayed on the screen.

Molbio Diagnostics IPO allotment on NSE

Step 1. Visit the NSE website at https://www.nseindia.com/invest/check-trades-bids-verify-ipo-bids
Step 2. Select Molbio Diagnostics from the list of issues.
Step 3. Enter the required application details.
Step 4. Enter the captcha, if prompted.
Step 5. Submit the details to view the application status.
Step 6. Molbio Diagnostics IPO: Anchor investors

Ahead of the public issue, Molbio Diagnostics raised Rs 281.5 crore from anchor investors. According to the company's exchange filing dated August 7, it allotted 34.87 lakh equity shares to 33 anchor investors.

Among global investors, Goldman Sachs invested Rs 30 crore, while the International Finance Corporation (IFC) and BlackRock Global Funds invested Rs 20 crore each.

Domestic mutual funds accounted for a significant part of the anchor allocation. Molbio Diagnostics allotted 23.54 lakh shares to nine domestic mutual funds through 19 schemes. The investors included HDFC Mutual Fund, Kotak Mahindra Asset Management Company, ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company, Nippon India Mutual Fund, Mirae Asset, WhiteOak Capital, Motilal Oswal Asset Management Company, Tata Mutual Fund and Edelweiss Mutual Fund.

The company also allotted 2.65 lakh shares worth Rs 21.44 crore to 10 life insurance companies.

The Rs 940-crore IPO comprises a fresh issue of Rs 200 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 91.66 lakh shares worth around Rs 739.7 crore by existing shareholders.

Check IPO News Here

Molbio Diagnostics plans to use Rs 105.5 crore from the fresh issue to establish a research and development facility and Centre of Excellence through its subsidiary Bigtec. The funds will also be used for office space for the company, its subsidiaries and associate entities.

Another Rs 72.2 crore has been earmarked for purchasing plant, machinery and equipment for the company's manufacturing facilities in Goa and Visakhapatnam. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

Kotak Mahindra Capital Company, IIFL Capital Services, Jefferies India and Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors are the book-running lead managers to the issue.

About Molbio Diagnostics

Goa-based Molbio Diagnostics is a point-of-care molecular diagnostics company backed by Temasek and entities associated with the Motilal Oswal Group. The company offers molecular diagnostic tests covering 30 diseases through 43 assays.

Molbio's platform is designed to enable decentralised molecular testing and has been deployed in resource-constrained settings. Its products are aimed at providing molecular diagnostic capabilities closer to the point of care.

1.headline: Dhoot Transmission IPO allotment today; check status on registrar, BSE and NSE
1.heading: Dhoot Transmission IPO allotment today; check status on registrar, BSE and NSE
1.intro: Dhoot Transmission is expected to finalise the basis of allotment for its initial public offering (IPO) today, on August 13, after the Rs 3,067-crore issue drew strong demand across investor categories.
1.body:
Dhoot Transmission is expected to finalise the basis of allotment for its initial public offering (IPO) today, on August 13, after the Rs 3,067-crore issue drew strong demand across investor categories.

The IPO was subscribed 74.21 times by the close of bidding on August 12, according to data from the National Stock Exchange (NSE).

The issue received bids for 1,85,19,71,585 equity shares against 2,49,56,363 shares on offer. Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIBs) placed the strongest demand, with their portion subscribed 212.92 times. The Non-Institutional Investor (NII) category was subscribed 51.93 times, while the retail portion was subscribed 8.12 times.

The IPO opened on August 10 and closed on August 12. Dhoot Transmission had fixed the price band at Rs 829 to Rs 871 per equity share, with the upper end of the band being used to calculate the issue's implied listing premium.

Read Also: N Chandrasekaran Net Worth: Rs 685 crore pay in 5 years, Rs 98 crore duplex in Mumbai — his journey from TCS intern to Tata Sons chairman

According to IPO-tracking platforms InvestorGain and IPO Watch, Dhoot Transmission shares were commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of around Rs 276 over the upper end of the IPO price band of Rs 871. This indicated a potential premium of nearly 32 percent over the issue price.

The GMP is an unofficial indicator based on activity in the grey market and can change before the stock's listing. It does not guarantee listing gains and should not be treated as an indication of the company's actual market valuation.

Dhoot Transmission IPO allotment status: How to check on registrar, BSE and NSE

The basis of allotment for the Dhoot Transmission IPO is expected to be finalised on August 13. Once the allotment is released, investors can check their status through the IPO registrar KFin Technologies, as well as the BSE and NSE websites.

Dhoot Transmission IPO allotment on KFin Technologies

Step 1. Visit the KFin Technologies IPO allotment status page at https://ipostatus.kfintech.com/
Step 2. Select Dhoot Transmission from the list of IPOs.
Step 3. Select the mode through which you want to check the status — PAN, application number or DP ID/Client ID.
Step 4. Enter the required details.
Step 5. Enter the captcha and click on Submit.
Step 6. Your Dhoot Transmission IPO allotment status will be displayed on the screen.

Dhoot Transmission IPO allotment on BSE

1. Visit the BSE website and open the IPO application status page at https://www.bseindia.com/investors/appli_check
2. Select Equity under the issue type.
3. Select Dhoot Transmission from the issue name.
4. Enter your PAN or application number.
5. Enter the captcha displayed on the screen.
6. Click on Submit to view your allotment status.

Dhoot Transmission IPO allotment on NSE

Step 1. Visit the NSE website and open the IPO bid verification/application status page at https://www.nseindia.com/invest/check-trades-bids-verify-ipo-bids
Step 2. Select Dhoot Transmission from the list of IPOs.
Step 3. Enter your application number and other required details.
Step 4. Enter the captcha, if prompted.
Step 5. Submit the details to check your IPO application and allotment status.
Step 6. Investors can also check their status through their respective broker platforms, where the IPO application may show whether shares have been allotted, not allotted or are still pending.

Check IPO News Here

Ahead of the IPO, Dhoot Transmission raised Rs 918.3 crore from anchor investors. The anchor book included institutional investors such as BlackRock, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and SBI Mutual Fund.

The company plans to use proceeds from the fresh issue primarily to repay or prepay certain borrowings. A portion of the funds will also be invested in subsidiaries to help them reduce debt.

Dhoot Transmission has also earmarked funds to establish new wiring harness manufacturing facilities at Jhajjar in Haryana and Shoolagiri in Hosur, Tamil Nadu. The company plans to use the remaining funds for potential acquisitions and other strategic initiatives.

The IPO's basis of allotment is expected to be finalised on August 13, while the company's shares are scheduled to list on the BSE and NSE on August 17.

About Dhoot Transmission

Founded in 1999, Dhoot Transmission manufactures wiring harnesses and automotive electrical and electronic components. Its product portfolio includes electronic sensors and controllers, automotive switches, power cords, cables, connectors and terminals.

The company's products are used across multiple segments, including two-wheelers, three-wheelers, commercial vehicles, off-road vehicles, earth-moving equipment, agricultural machinery, medical devices and domestic appliances.

2.headline: Gaja Capital fixes price band at Rs 152-160 per share, Rs 550-crore IPO to open next week
2.heading: Gaja Capital fixes price band at Rs 152-160 per share, Rs 550-crore IPO to open next week
2.intro: Gaja Capital IPO | The initial share sale will open for public subscription from August 19 to August 21, while the anchor book will be launched for one day on August 18.
2.body:
Gopal Jain-promoted Gaja Alternative Asset Management, which operates under the Gaja Capital brand, has set a price band of Rs 152-160 per share for its Rs 550-crore initial public offering. At the upper end of the band, the company would be valued at Rs 2,256 crore.

The IPO will open for subscription on August 19 and close on August 21. The anchor-investor book will open for a day on August 18.

The offer comprises a fresh issue worth Rs 450 crore and an offer for sale of up to Rs 100 crore by select promoters and other shareholders.

Gaja Capital manages India-focused funds, including Category I and Category II alternative investment funds. It also advises offshore funds that invest in Indian companies.

The company plans to use Rs 372 crore from the net fresh-issue proceeds to meet sponsor commitments to certain existing and new funds and repay a bridge loan. The balance will be used for general corporate purposes.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

Up to 50 percent of the offer has been reserved for qualified institutional buyers, while at least 35 percent has been set aside for retail investors and 15 percent for non-institutional investors.

Investors can bid for a minimum of 93 shares and in multiples of 93 thereafter. At the upper price band, one lot would cost Rs 14,880. A retail investor can apply for up to 13 lots, amounting to Rs 1,93,440.

For the year ended March 2026, Gaja Alternative Asset Management net profit rose 33.8 percent to Rs 79.7 crore. Revenue increased 11.1 percent to Rs 135.5 crore from the previous financial year.

The company has identified 360 ONE WAM, Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC, Anand Rathi Wealth, HDFC AMC, ICICI Prudential AMC, Nippon Life India Asset Management and SBI Funds Management as its peers, although Gaja is substantially smaller than most companies in the group.

JM Financial and IIFL Capital Services are the book-running lead managers to the issue.
